mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `cors`.`shop_items` (`shop_id`,`item_name`, `color`, `size`, `price`,`style` ,`main_category`, `sub_category`, `detail_category`, `created_at`, `updated_at`) VALUES (#{item.shopId}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.color}, #{item.size}, #{item.price}, #{item.style}, #{item.mainCategory}, #{item.subCategory}, #{item.detailCategory}, IFNULL(#{item.createdAt}, NOW()), IFNULL(#{item.updatedAt}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC
SELECT `user_email` AS `userEmail`, `shop_id` AS `shopId`, `item_id` AS `itemId`, `created_at` AS `createdAt` FROM `cors`.`like_items`

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si WHERE si.`shop_id` = #{shopId} ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC

SELECT `id` AS `id`, `shop_id` AS `shopId`, `item_name` AS `itemName`, `color` AS `color`, `size` AS `size`, `price` AS `price`, `style` AS `style`, `main_category` AS `mainCategory`, `sub_category` AS `subCategory`, `detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, `created_at` AS `createdAt`, `updated_at` AS `updateAt`, `deleted_at` AS `deletedAt` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` WHERE `id` = #{id} LIMIT 1;

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si /* [수정 1] 주소 비교를 위해 매장 정보 테이블과 조인 */ JOIN `cors`.`shop_info` info ON si.`shop_id` = info.`shop_id` WHERE si.`style` = #{style} /* [수정 2] 주소 우선순위 정렬 로직 추가 */ ORDER BY (CASE WHEN info.`shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{address}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN info.`shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{region}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, si.`updated_at` DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, img.id AS img_id, -- 이미지 컬럼은 이름 겹치니까 별명 붙이기 img.image_path AS img_path, img.original_name AS img_name FROM `cors`.`shop_items` AS `si` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`shop_item_images` AS `img` ON `si`.id = `img`.product_id WHERE si.id = #{id}

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, info.`shop_name` AS `shopName`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si JOIN `cors`.`shop_info` info ON si.`shop_id` = info.`shop_id` WHERE 1=1
(si.`item_name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`main_category` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`sub_category` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`detail_category` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`style` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR info.`shop_name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC

SELECT `shop_id` AS `shopId`, `user_email` AS `userEmail`, `shop_name` AS `shopName`, `shop_time` AS `shopTime`, `shop_category` AS `shopCategory`, `shop_address` AS `shopAddress`, `shop_tel` AS `shopTel`, `profile_image` AS `profileImage`, `background_image` AS `backgroundImage` FROM `cors`.`shop_info` WHERE 1=1
(`shop_name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR `shop_category` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY `shop_id` DESC

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, info.`shop_name` AS `shopName`, /* 요청하신 이미지 서브쿼리 */ (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath`, li.`created_at` AS `createdAt` FROM `cors`.`like_items` li INNER JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON li.`item_id` = si.`id` INNER JOIN `cors`.`shop_info` info ON li.`shop_id` = info.`shop_id` WHERE li.`user_email` = #{userEmail} ORDER BY li.`created_at` DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cors`.`shop_items` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL
